route: C: permutation-invariant variable-camera observation/geometry-only warm initializer for three-dimensional BOST reconstruction
headline: v143 closes the shared-linear Riesz-action hypothesis: the regularized inverse is numerically suitable, but 0/20 preregistered held-out sentinels pass and every trajectory tail is near unit error
headline_zh: v143 关闭共享线性 Riesz-action 假设：正则化逆本身数值稳定，但 20 个结果前留出哨兵 0/20 通过，五条轨迹尾部误差都接近 1。
next_scientific_gate: before any new model, run a small CPU identifiability diagnostic that asks whether deployment-visible feature neighborhoods contain a consistent held-out Riesz-action target; close this target if they do not, and only then consider a separately frozen minimal nonlinear sentinel
next_scientific_gate_en: Before any new model, run a small CPU identifiability diagnostic asking whether deployment-visible feature neighborhoods contain a consistent held-out Riesz-action target. Close this target if they do not; only a positive result may authorize a separately frozen minimal nonlinear sentinel. Do not rent a GPU now.
next_scientific_gate_zh: 在任何新模型之前，先用小型 CPU 可辨识性诊断检验：部署可见特征的局部邻域里，留出轨迹的 Riesz-action 目标是否一致。若不一致就关闭该目标；只有诊断为正，才另冻最小非线性哨兵。当前不租 GPU。
